scope: Assess coherence, feasibility and alignment with the brief; no research packages completed, no solver run, no GitHub project assumptions published

annotation_assessments.proposal: Baseline uses fixed total generation plus specified independent wind profile; remove independent wind only in ablation
annotation_assessments.assessment: Workable constructed-system convention; do not re-optimize existing generation in Tier1

annotation_assessments.proposal: Use later non-inclusion conclusion
annotation_assessments.assessment: Adopt separate simulated farm as additional to background total for the model. Total already includes offshore/onshore wind categories; no deletion of those categories. Distinguish the chosen connection convention from an explicit CSV provenance statement about a particular facility

annotation_assessments.proposal: Use confirmed demand definition
annotation_assessments.assessment: Given constructed-system demand, described at UK scale. Does not establish client's own behind-meter load

annotation_assessments.proposal: Background generation fixed; technology dispatchability research as optional experiment
annotation_assessments.assessment: Sound. Dispatchability alone does not justify free redispatch: also needs available capacities, costs and operating constraints

annotation_assessments.proposal: Pool electricity regardless of generation source
annotation_assessments.assessment: Fine for aggregate energy/economic model. Renewable-specific utilisation/capture claims require provenance accounting or must be labelled total-electricity metrics

annotation_assessments.proposal: Economic and demand-coverage objectives
annotation_assessments.assessment: Valid. Recommend primary incremental NPV with coverage/unused energy KPIs and optional epsilon-constraint tradeoff, not an arbitrary unit-mixing sum. Battery-discharge sales are electricity revenue, not another hardware revenue

annotation_assessments.proposal: No baseline hard supply guarantee
annotation_assessments.assessment: Valid if unmet demand is explicit and reported; not the same as ignoring the demand series

annotation_assessments.proposal: Incremental investment and revenue/cost comparisons; omit existing capital costs
annotation_assessments.assessment: Existing sunk capital and unchanged costs may be omitted in incremental objective. Changed operating costs and displaced electricity sales cannot be omitted

annotation_assessments.proposal: Chronological train/validation with fixed learned capacities and global/validation oracles
annotation_assessments.assessment: Strong design. Separate capacity information from operational information. Fixed-capacity full-validation optimization is an operational oracle, not a fully causal strategy. Validation-only oracle is an upper bound only under matched feasible set, information, horizon and accounting; all-years optimum need not dominate on validation subset

annotation_assessments.proposal: Date intersection and cleaned train/validation data
annotation_assessments.assessment: Reasonable. Removed dates can break SOC continuity; require explicit gap/segment treatment, report retained coverage, and avoid fitting cleaning thresholds on held-out data

annotation_assessments.proposal: Lenient deterministic cleaning; 2/3-sigma alternative
annotation_assessments.assessment: Keep negative prices and genuine tail events. Statistical rarity is a flag, not proof of erroneous data. Do not label all extreme-event exclusions as cleaning

annotation_assessments.proposal: Daily granularity on user's Ultra9 275HX and RTX5090 laptop budget
annotation_assessments.assessment: Reasonable starting point; pilot runtime and optimization gap rather than promise hardware-based solve time. Daily observations cannot identify intraday 2-hour battery arbitrage

annotation_assessments.proposal: Equal day weights
annotation_assessments.assessment: Fine for full daily observations. Distinct from financial discounting and annualisation; do not extrapolate selectively missing days to a full year without justification

annotation_assessments.proposal: Prioritise self-supply, then economically optimize charge/hydrogen/discharge; deficit penalty deferred
annotation_assessments.assessment: Needs definition of self-supply. If supplied demand is the sales market, forcing it first conflicts with equal sale-vs-charge choice. If a separate internal load is introduced, define its source and avoided cost; no hard guarantee is compatible with reporting residual unmet demand

annotation_assessments.proposal: Research sales headroom; assume unlimited if unavailable; equal sale/charge decisions; battery timing by lifetime/prices
annotation_assessments.assessment: Sale-vs-charge choice is appropriate. Unlimited sales cannot silently erase the supplied demand's role. Keep as explicit market alternative if chosen. Initial sizing/lifetime can be baseline; dynamic equipment acquisition/replacement timing is a separate extension

annotation_assessments.proposal: Grid purchases only with sufficient evidence
annotation_assessments.assessment: Reasonable conservative fallback: disabled in baseline until tariff/access/limits are specified. Unlimited imports plus profitable unlimited hydrogen outlet and scalable investment can make the model unbounded

annotation_assessments.proposal: Purchase/sale prices based on research
annotation_assessments.assessment: Appropriate; do not infer equal import/export tariff or full retail price from wholesale price column

annotation_assessments.proposal: Research quantity-dependent prices
annotation_assessments.assessment: Appropriate; a price-taking baseline is a labelled simplification if market impact parameters are unavailable, especially with aggregate-system scale

annotation_assessments.proposal: Research curtailment economics
annotation_assessments.assessment: Appropriate; no assumed compensation or free opportunity value without justification. Report physical unused energy independently

annotation_assessments.proposal: Retain classroom network/geography simplification
annotation_assessments.assessment: Aligned with brief and lecture; no baseline transmission/locational model required

annotation_assessments.proposal: Research topic 1: electricity trading and operations
annotation_assessments.assessment: Coherent package; end with sourced parameters, applicability, uncertainty and fallback assumptions, not an exhaustive market simulation

annotation_assessments.proposal: Research suitable battery specifications; use current technology in historical years without launch constraints
annotation_assessments.assessment: Valid present-technology historical counterfactual, not a historically deployable investment claim. Use a finite justified candidate set, normalise installed cost/power/energy/SOC/lifetime/efficiency and price vintage

annotation_assessments.proposal: Research topic 3: electrolyser products, hydrogen storage and markets
annotation_assessments.assessment: Coherent. Direct H2 sale can be minimal baseline; storage/transport/reconversion need their own cost and outlet assumptions if included

annotation_assessments.proposal: Technology capex set by research
annotation_assessments.assessment: Appropriate; account for installed-system boundaries, operations, replacement, residual value, currency and base year. Preserve source ranges for sensitivity

annotation_assessments.proposal: Risk-free rate and exponential compounding
annotation_assessments.assessment: Risk-free case can be a financing benchmark but does not alone represent risky project investor's hurdle rate. Use effective-annual discounting with consistent real/nominal cash flows; continuous rate rho=ln(1+r) if using exponential discounting

remaining_before_freezing_baseline: Role of given system demand versus internal load and external sales headroom
Single primary economic objective and any coverage constraints or Pareto experiments
Finite technology candidates, installed costs, lifetime and operating/financial parameters
Daily state transitions including missing dates, starting/terminal inventories and energy units
Capacity-fitting versus causal-operation versus hindsight-oracle evaluation protocols
